# tplinkrouter_portal_page (Data Source)

Edit an existing local portal page. Destroy releases management without deleting the page.

## 范围与行为

- 分类：authentication。
- SLP 读取对象：`authentication.portal_page_list`。
- 管理页面证据：`/userrpm/template.htm; local_template.htm; /web-static/js/cloud/cwm-device.js`。
- 只读查询，不修改运行配置，也不执行保存。秘密写入字段不暴露为读取属性。
- 返回全部匹配条目；筛选由此类型固定的设备接口约束决定，无通用 JSON 输入或选择器。

Supports existing local pages only. The template manager creates metadata and editor content in separate stages; complete template creation, template deletion, cloud-hosted templates, and image uploads are not implemented. Omitted or unknown fields in the stored page configuration are preserved when updating known fields.
